B1d room CKCrusaders (order 579, group 2: the B1b room note left kinds for B1d in t01, t03, t04, t05, t06 and t07) reread: A1 note, 7 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (84 threads, 319 lines, not cut). No change. Kinds missing from t01's bag (T3-004 with T3-021, T3-010, T3-038), recorded here: T3-091 putting the room on one template, carried by two carrying codes of the A1 note (c0032, one official design declared and all others to be ignored; c0049, revisions keeping people working against themselves) with c0045 (the Discord design brought back with measurements); T3-041 trying a bigger second piece (c0005, c0015, c0016, c0019, c0022, the second and third shields); T3-169 (c0027, c0042, Paradox or the sub's name at the top). Named here, beside themes that already hold three kinds: t04 T3-151 (c0056, Norway's help for replacing Turkey's flag; c0069, mutual help with Texas against Norway) and T3-087 (c0061, c0066); t06 T3-142 (c0071, an anti-Turkish slogan, and c0047, saracens), T3-005 (c0030, c0047, c0058) and T3-038 (c0031, c0037); single concepts t03 T3-167 (c0036, a timed pixel charge) and T3-191 (c0017, a personal signature refused as a team effort), t05 T3-042 (c0051) and t07 T3-117 (c0080). Carrying codes: c0059 (do not brigade Norway) is carried by T3-076 in t04; c0032 and c0049 as above. For the T3-188 gate on outside voices: c0066, a member setting Norge rogues apart from the official Norwegian ally, with c0061 asking whether Norway or random placers did the damage; one member of both communities asking them not to fight (c0086), the open distinction of one member on both sides. National and political content read plainly: the crusade framing against Turkey, a call to conquer it and recapture Constantinople (c0085), an anti-Turkish slogan for the next target with r/greece (c0071), the Turkish flag to be replaced by the Byzantine one (c0063) and Norway's help to replace it for Greece (c0056), in t06's T3-081 and T3-006; Muslims called heathens in a thread on a crescent-and-Jihad shield (c0011) and saracens (c0047); Korea to be removed from claimed land (c0048); the Nordic countries' attack (c0044), the non-aggression pact with Sweden and the kingdoms of the north (c0033), Norway's rogues and alliance (c0059, c0066); a neighbouring Trump build argued not to encroach (c0050); r/Catholicism said to make the design (c0064); a march against Texas and later help for it (c0057, c0069); Plan Shqip (c0077). Nothing left out or softened. The A1 note's not-this holds: the crusade talk sat beside alliances and calls not to brigade (c0033, c0054, c0059). No new kind; the run is not reset.

B1d room math (order 580, group 1: the B1c test found the gate failing in t04, T3-010 against T3-149 for non-aggression pacts) reread: A1 note, 9 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (41 threads, 201 lines, not cut). No change. t04 (borders, help and coexistence with neighbours) stays in T3-149 with T3-072 and T3-011: the pact came after r/heroesofthestorm's build was reported invading the identity (c0027), was offered from that room (c0014, c0025) and was kept as an agreement not to go over the equation (c0028, a carrying code of the A1 note), a truce ending an encroachment already under way. For B1e, the T3-010/T3-149 discriminator should say that a pact ending or forestalling a fight between rooms already in contact goes to T3-149, and an agreement drawing borders or sharing space where no fight began goes to T3-010. The rest hold: an unnamed contest recognised (t01 T3-016), calls for mathematical marks (t02 T3-033 with T3-002), upkeep (t03 bag under T3-021), recognition and credit (t05 T3-009 with T3-082 and T3-043), damage, giving up and refusals (t06 T3-073 with T3-075 and T3-181), the room's own fakes (t07 T3-001), maths jokes on the mark (t08 T3-031), the project explained (t09 T3-016). Carrying codes: c0003 (recruiting help for Euler's identity) is carried by T3-002 in t02; c0030 (every dot counts) by T3-021 in t03's bag. Named here: t02 T3-028 (c0021) and T3-020 (c0065, c0068); t04 T3-151 (c0055, help with e for moving it) and T3-183 (c0075, the identity choking out another room's cat); t06 T3-098 (c0066, c0078, bare refusals of a call, the glasgow t02 case for the T3-037/T3-098 discriminator) and T3-037 (c0059); t07 c0018, a joke on the comment counts the company's April Fools changed, near T3-048. The A1 note's not-this holds: most mathematical calls drew one or two replies, some only a refusal (c0066, c0078). No national or political content; a misogynist copypasta explained as an April Fools joke (c0024) is in T3-001. Nothing left out or softened. No new kind; the run is not reset.

National and political content read plainly: r/straya and r/australia as rival then mates, in their own register (c0037, c0078, c0167, c0173), the Steve Irwin tribute and the croc (c0142, c0158, c0159), r/portugal's request and a shared nation (c0134, c0170, c0172), the redback (c0163). Nothing left out or softened. The A1 note's not-this holds: the room spent most turns repairing neighbours (c0058, c0102, c0106, c0143). No new kind; the run is not reset.

B1d room PlaceNL (order 597, group 1: the B1c test found T3-046 against T3-076 in t14, registering the end in t19, organisers conceding in t11, crossposting in t13 and a slip in t20; and group 2) reread: A1 note, 21 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (101 threads, 524 lines, not cut). One change, a bag (out/_analysis/b1d06_bags_PlaceNL.txt, checked with b1_precheck_bagfile.py and b1_check_bags.py; two tier lines written, tier_history 105; multiplacement 6,653): t14 (fighting among ourselves over whether the Yeti stays) held T3-046 with T3-011 and T3-045; c0125, a carrying code of the A1 note, is a member running scripts to remove the Yeti against the room's call to spare it, and c0213 the same member's friends demolishing it with ten accounts as each one's own game, defying the room's call to hold back (T3-102, which holds nyjets' insisting on hitting the Bills after being told no and xcom's call to break a treaty). With four kinds it is now one placement in T3-046 with T3-011, T3-045 and T3-102 in the bag line; T3-011 and T3-045 were unplaced. The B1c failure in t14, T3-046 against T3-076: the reining in is c0122 (killing the Yeti called the room's death sentence, kept in T3-046's part) and c0132 (a scripter told to stop and look), one concept of its own, named here; the T3-046/T3-076 discriminator is owed for B1e. Also named in t14: c0123 and c0131, randoms and rogues blamed for driving the flag through the Yeti and outsiders asked to message them, the T3-188 doing in two concepts beside t11, which holds T3-188 since B1d-01. t11 holds (T3-188 with T3-049; c0097, a carrying code, the organised Discord members set apart from many Dutch placers). t19 (finding out too late that Place ended) stays in T3-117, another case for T3-117 taking registering the end. t13 (crossposting) stays in T3-070 with T3-013. t20 (a sarcastic thanks to a summoned bot, c0155) stays unplaced. Carrying codes: c0081 (reviewing art and dividing space among groups wronged) is carried by T3-012, kept in t09's bag. Named here, beside themes that hold three kinds: t03 T3-124 (c0005); t07 T3-151 (c0059, c0060, Puerto Rico's flag rebuilt for help against the Void), T3-149 (c0046), T3-195 (c0064, agreements kept) and T3-139 (c0079, c0096); t10 T3-077 (c0087, scripted animation proposed; T3-077 holds one theme, Mario's flashing toadstool, so this is a second room's single concept for the floor at B1e); t11 T3-136 (c0040, c0130); t12 T3-009 (c0048, c0220) and T3-130 (c0077, a riff on Make America Great Again for the Netherlands; c0242, Dutch numbers compared with r/The_Donald's). National and political content read plainly: the Dutch flag, the Wilhelmus and the spelling of Duitschen bloed (c0183, c0184, c0207, c0243), the royal couple and the king's name (c0031, c0138), VOC ships and Delft tiles (c0089, c0156), the provinces (c0020, c0090, c0104); colonisation language for taking ground, Indonesia as easy spoils (c0035), the west colonised (c0078), a petition to colonise South Africa again answered with VOC mentality (c0141, c0142), African brothers (c0072), Puerto Rico wiped off the map and colonised enough (c0055, c0070), Singapore accused of defiling Dutch land (c0056, c0057), Greece bought fairly (c0041), congratulations on a successful colonisation (c0206, c0212); Czechia's friendship rejected and defended (c0066, c0102, c0103, c0217); Sweden's friendship (c0218, c0219); the Norwegian flag's cheese slicer (c0100); the Dominican, Albanian and EU flags (c0079, c0120, c0143). Nothing left out or softened. The A1 note's not-this holds: the room said its plans did not control the Dutch masses (c0097, c0168). No new kind; the run is not reset.
